title: The Lost Sheep! 🐑 Jesus, Our Good Shepherd | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
top:
A little lamb is lost, all alone on a dark hill! 🐑 Who will come and find it? Join us for Jesus' parable of the Lost Sheep from Luke 15 and learn how much God loves us.

The good shepherd left the ninety nine sheep to look for the one that was lost, and when he found it, he carried it home full of joy! Jesus told us there is big joy in heaven when one person says sorry to God and comes back to Him. 💛

📖 Memory verse: "The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want." (Psalm 23:1)
🎯 Lesson: Repentance and forgiveness. Jesus is our Good Shepherd, and God is happy when we say sorry!
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
